name: Beijing-Shanghai High-Speed Railway Co.,Ltd.
summary: Beijing-Shanghai High-Speed Railway Co.,Ltd. is responsible for both developing and managing passenger high-speed rail services. The rail line it operates spans a significant corridor, connecting the major regions of Beijing, Tianjin, Hebei, Shandong, Anhui, Jiangsu, and Shanghai. Established in 2007, the company maintains its corporate headquarters in Beijing, China.
